Product Details: The XTRA POWER Full Magnetic Nut Holder in gold finish is a reliable and efficient fastener drive bit designed for professional and DIY use alike. Measuring 8MM x 65MM, this nut holder features a full magnetic design that firmly grips nuts and fasteners, preventing them from slipping or falling during use. This ensures precise and hassle-free fastening, even in hard-to-reach areas. The gold finish not only adds a sleek appearance but also provides added durability for long-lasting performance. Compatible with standard power drills and screwdrivers, this magnetic nut holder is ideal for a wide range of applications including construction, automotive work, and general repairs. This pack contains 10 pieces, making it a practical choice for workshops, toolboxes, and job sites where multiple units are needed. The strong magnetic hold ensures nuts stay securely in place throughout the fastening process, improving efficiency and reducing the risk of dropped hardware. A must-have addition to any toolkit.
